description: session_engaged must check both string_value='1' and int_value=1 due to GA4 schema inconsistency
source_incident: 100% bounce rate bug — GA4 stores session_engaged as string in some events and int in others

description: Engagement must be computed at session level via CTE before summing, not directly from raw events
source_incident: Negative bounce rate bug — multiple engaged events per session inflated engaged_sessions > total_sessions

description: All division in SQL must use SAFE_DIVIDE to prevent zero-denominator crashes
source_incident: Runtime BQ error — channels with 0 sessions caused division-by-zero crashes
